Record notes

Eleven development workflows with full Superpowers, Alpic and original local MCP procedures.

Version 0.1.1 includes 11 complete skill procedures. Complete source methods and synthetic local-MCP starter; external provider tools separate.

Requirements: Host coding tools; Runtime named by the selected workflow.

License scope: MIT AND Apache-2.0. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add development-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files and includes a per-file hash inventory. Built from 65519bccb27654c9cc9bfd1878ed0084b48316a9. SHA-256: 9e5c29ab5a0e4816f6c2d5482bab601da54c8110274db88214068a51c3d7d2ef.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
